_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Committed to the repo so teammates pick up the same wiring. Tokens are read from env vars — never paste secrets here.

github._comment: Official GitHub MCP server (github/github-mcp-server) run locally via Docker. Provides mcp__github__* tools for PRs, issues, code search, Actions, etc. Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN at user-scope (see docs/copilot-instructions/MCP-SETUP.md) — Docker must be running.
